name: @helm/desktop
description: Helm's Electron shell: main process, preload, renderer.
//productName: Electron derives app.getName() - and therefore %APPDATA%\<name> - from this file. Without productName a scoped package name puts the database in %APPDATA%\@helm/desktop, creating a nested folder from the scope. electron-builder sets the same value for packaged builds.
author: Cole Taylor

scripts.//dev: --watch is what makes the main process and preload reload too. Without it electron-vite only gives the renderer HMR, and every main-process edit needs the app killed and restarted by hand.
scripts.//m2-check: M2's acceptance criteria, driven through the real app window. Spawns real claude sessions and ends them; see src/main/m2check.ts.
scripts.//m3-check: M3's acceptance criteria. Builds a profile through the real form, launches it, and asks the live session whether the composition worked. Three phases, orchestrated by run-m3.mjs rather than by && because node-pty's teardown loses the exit code; the report is the verdict. Pass --only=compose|fixture|shims through to re-run one group.
scripts.//m4-check: M4's acceptance criteria. Drives the session-history pane through the real window and checks every count against an independent read of ~/.claude/history.jsonl. Spawns two real claude sessions - one resumed through the app, one on its own pty to prove the index notices a session Helm did not start - so it takes minutes. Verdict is in m4-report.json; run-m4.mjs exists for the same reason run-m3.mjs does.
scripts.//m5-check: M5's acceptance criteria. Drives the config console through the real window: browses every scope against an independent readdir walk, edits a file in each and restores it hash-verified, adds an MCP server through the UI, then launches a real claude session and asks it whether the effective view predicted what it actually sees. Spawns one claude session on haiku, so it takes minutes. Pass --only=browse|edit|snapshot|json|external|mcp|effective|doctor to re-run one group.
scripts.//m6-check: M6's acceptance criteria. Opens every markdown file in the user's harness vault through the real window and checks the DOM it produced against a regex read of the same source, navigates a wikilink, interrogates the artifact frame's sandbox from inside it, measures search latency and scroll frame intervals, and edits a real note through the split editor with a hash-verified restore. Spawns no claude sessions, so it takes about a minute. Pass --only=browse|render|links|artifact|search|edit|scroll to re-run one group.
scripts.//usage-check: The status bar's usage figures. Drives the real window: checks the painted percentages against its own JSON.parse of ~/.claude.json, watches a rewritten fixture reach the bar with no restart, lets a usage window roll over underneath the segment, points the reader at six broken readings and proves each paints nothing, measures the bar at four widths in both themes, measures the full transcript parse it avoids, and finally asks a live claude for /usage and compares. Pass --only=read|watch|resets|degrade|setting|width|cost|live to re-run one group.
